result.summary: Mostly made of injection moulded ABS plastic housing with a DC motor and lithium ion battery.

parts.name: Keyless chuck
parts.process_detail: Steel jaws are precision machined and assembled into a threaded body with a plastic grip.
parts.fun_fact: Keyless chucks use a ratcheting mechanism that allows one handed tightening up to 50 Nm.

parts.name: Motor housing
parts.process_detail: Yellow ABS is injected into a two part mould with integrated vents for cooling.
parts.fun_fact: The ventilation slots are positioned to draw air over the motor for cooling during heavy use.

parts.name: DC brushless motor
parts.process_detail: Copper wire is wound around stator poles and magnets are fixed inside the housing.
parts.fun_fact: Brushless motors last 10 times longer than brushed motors and deliver 30 percent more runtime.

parts.name: Trigger switch
parts.process_detail: Trigger is moulded with a variable resistor contact that controls motor speed electronically.
parts.fun_fact: Variable speed triggers use pulse width modulation to control motor speed up to 20000 times per second.

parts.name: Handle grip
parts.process_detail: Hard ABS handle is moulded first then soft TPE rubber is overmoulded for grip.
parts.fun_fact: Overmoulding bonds rubber to plastic chemically during injection creating a permanent grip surface.

parts.name: Battery pack
parts.process_detail: Individual 18650 lithium cells are welded together and enclosed in injection moulded ABS housing.
parts.fun_fact: Modern drill batteries use the same 18650 cells found in Tesla vehicles and laptops.

parts.name: Gearbox assembly
parts.process_detail: Planetary gears are machined from steel or moulded nylon and assembled into a metal housing.
parts.fun_fact: Planetary gearboxes can achieve 50 to 1 reduction ratios in a compact space using three stages.

parts.name: Forward reverse switch
parts.process_detail: Sliding switch reverses motor polarity by mechanically switching electrical contacts inside the housing.
parts.fun_fact: Reversing switches change the direction of current flow through the motor to reverse rotation instantly.

journey.title: Plastic pellets sourced
journey.detail: ABS and TPE pellets are produced from petroleum derivatives at chemical plants.

journey.title: Components manufactured
journey.detail: Housing parts are injection moulded, motor wound, gears machined, and battery cells produced.

journey.title: Drill assembled
journey.detail: Motor, gearbox, switch, and electronics are assembled into the housing with automated screwdrivers.

journey.title: Performance tested
journey.detail: Each drill is tested for torque, speed, and electrical safety before packaging.

journey.title: Shipped to retailers
journey.detail: Drills are packed in cardboard boxes and shipped by container to distribution centers.

journey.title: Arrives at buyer
journey.detail: Customer purchases from hardware store or online and receives the drill ready to use.
